payload.title: File:Venaticosuchus skull diagram.png
payload.description_html: A color-coded skull diagram of Venaticosaurus rusconii, mostly based on a diagram published by Von Baczko (2018). Dotted lines indicate missing bone (i.e. the dorsal part of the skull), which has been reconstructed primarily based on Riojasuchus.
